source_policy: release 2026.11.13-confined-fallbacks: more failure modes are confined to the element that fails instead of the page (a paragraph whose translation leaves a protected sign without a figure near it is retried, then kept in source, by a proximity check for one known failure, not a check of every number in running text; table cells of several rows extracted as one element keep their exact source ink; text the source page does not show is neither translated nor redrawn); the numeric row guard reads more signed and currency spellings; placeholder leaks are caught across any whitespace; a page delivered as its source page keeps no partial-delivery records; prompts, configuration and caches unchanged
excluded_classes: production uploads, outputs, progress, tasks, caches, logs and installer state
fonts, audit evidence, backups and Git metadata
tests, test requirements and release tooling (kept in the source repository)
validation: Local regression suite: 2232 passed, 2 skipped (Python 3.13, constraints.txt, PyMuPDF 1.27.2.3), including tests for the sign proximity check, stacked table cells, invisible source text, the numeric row spellings, placeholder leaks across whitespace and the page record cleanup, each new condition checked by mutation; an offline, keyless reassembly of six real production jobs on the production host: no page newly restored to its source against the live release, no internal placeholder token in any text layer, no element recorded twice; five review rounds by two independent reviewers.
